messages:
maria_chen: Quick sync — UX question about the "latency by route" chart in Console. Are we standardizing on ms for axis units or switching to humanized (e.g. 1.2s / 120ms) depending on range? Need copy and a smoothing recommendation.
kevin_wang: I'd prefer humanized when values cross 1000ms, otherwise show ms. Keeps small numbers precise.
samir_a: FWIW frontend is fine switching label format dynamically. Need the exact rule though so I can implement tests.
elsa_viz: Two things: 1) Legend density — do we collapse secondary series by default? 2) Smoothing: should smoothing be on by default for customer dashboards (it hides spikes).
toni_access: Accessibility nit: if we auto-humanize units we must still expose full precise value on hover and in the table for screen reader reads.
maria_chen: Agree with Toni. Proposal: axis uses ms if max < 2000; otherwise use s with one decimal. Legend: show all series collapsed into a "more" menu when >4. Smoothing: default off, but provide a quick toggle labeled "Smooth (moving avg)" with aria-description.
kevin_wang: Language tweak: instead of "Smooth (moving avg)" maybe "Smoothing — moving average (3 samples)" so users know the window.
samir_a: Implementation note: moving avg window should be configurable server-side per metric. Frontend will read meta: {"smoothing_window":3}. Also we should clamp series outlier values for visualization only (not data) so axes don't blow up from noisy logs.
elsa_viz: For outliers I recommend an optional percentile clamp (e.g., 99th) with an overlay indicator when clamping occurs: small chevron on the axis + tooltip "Values above 99th percentile hidden from plot".
ton i_access: spelling: "toni_access" — tbc :) Also ARIA: the chevron tooltip needs role=tooltip and programmatic focus.
kevin_wang: Copy proposal for the clamp tooltip: "Note: very large values (>99th percentile) are omitted from this view to improve readability. Full values are available in the raw table." Thoughts?
samir_a: Fine. For tests I'll add a fixture where max value is 10x median to ensure clamp UI appears.
maria_chen: Can someone post a compact example for the config object we expect? That will speed Samir.
elsa_viz: Sure — example we can put in panel schema:
```json
{"axis_unit_rule":"auto_ms_to_s","unit_threshold_ms":"2000","smoothing_default":"off","smoothing_window":3,"legend_max_inline":4,"outlier_clamp_percentile":99}
```
kevin_wang: Copy note: prefer numbers not strings for thresholds (for schema clarity).
elsa_viz: updated snippet for devs:
```json
{"axis_unit_rule":"auto_ms_to_s","unit_threshold_ms":2000,"smoothing_default":false,"smoothing_window":3,"legend_max_inline":4,"outlier_clamp_percentile":99}
```
toni_access: Accessibility checklist: 1) smoothing toggle keyboard focus order 2) aria-live region for unit change when user toggles unit format 3) legend collapse must expose a listbox pattern for keyboard users.
maria_chen: Great checklist. Action items: Kevin—finalize copy for toggle + tooltip. Elsa—add schema PR with example and mock screenshots. Samir—implement clamp UI + tests. Toni—I'll loop you in on the PR for ARIA review. I'll update the docs after PRs land. :thumbsup:
kevin_wang: I'll send copy by EOD. :eyes:
elsa_viz: I'll open the schema PR in the morning.
samir_a: Starting dev work today, will flag if any perf surprises.
toni_access: Happy to review accessibility changes.
maria_chen: Thanks all. Closing thread once PRs are opened.
